climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A geographical indication on New Zealand's North Island, within the wider Hawke's Bay area. Hawke's Bay grows Chardonnay and Sauvignon Blanc most, each about 22% of its vines, then Merlot at 20% and Pinot Gris.
